'''Dean Patten''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[October 2000 Houlton tournament]] on 28 October 2000, according to Jayke Ball's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1406">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-30-houlton-maine-10-28-00d1406/ houlton-maine-10-28-00], DeckTech (Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball, 30 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-30-houlton-maine-10-28-00d1406/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
